description: Cochrane systematic reviews of health interventions, found through PubMed (journal Cochrane Database Syst Rev): PMID, title, publication date and DOI for a search term. Citation records only (no abstract, no full text). Up to 10 per call. Related tools on this server, for a different need: health_clinical_pharmacogenetics when you need CPIC pharmacogenetics guidelines for a gene symbol; health_clinical_trials_gov when you need ClinicalTrials.gov study search: NCT ID, title, status. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
